```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Here, we parse the output of the script.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

setwd(here::here("output"))
dimr_list <- readr::read_rds("umap_runs_20_cells_1000_scale_TRUE.rds")
```
```{r}
cell_id <- 1
one_cell <- lapply(dimr_list, function(i) {
    return(i[cell_id,])
}) %>% bind_rows()

one_cell
```

```{r}
ggplot(one_cell, aes(x = umap1, y = umap2)) + geom_point()
```
